title: Wheatfield Kitchen · Country kitchen in Malmesbury
text: Wheatfield Kitchen. Menu, For the children, Wine, Find us. Country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday, 12:00 to 15:00. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Book a table. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Sixty seats, on the stoep too. Wheelchair access. The menu: country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. The kitchen can leave out gluten or dairy on most dishes, if you ask when you book. The Sunday roast, R165. Lamb shank, R185. Chicken pie, R125. Vegetable bake, R115, vegetarian. Malva pudding, R65. For the children: a children's menu, each dish R75. Wine: wines from the Swartland and the Riebeek Valley, by the glass or the bottle. Corkage R60. Find us: open Tuesday to Sunday, lunch 12:00 to 15:00, and dinner 18:00 to 21:30 from Thursday to Saturday. Closed Mondays. Sixty seats inside and on the stoep, wheelchair access, and parking behind the restaurant. Groups of more than twelve, and private functions, by arrangement with the owner.
